definition: a surprise attack by people lying in wait in a concealed position
etymology: Old French 'embusche' from 'embuscher' meaning 'to set an ambush, to hide in the bushes'
contextSentence: The column came under ambush and was surrounded on three sides.
contextSentenceKo: 부대는 매복 공격을 받아 세 방향에서 포위당했습니다.

definition: the evacuation of military or other casualties to a hospital, especially by helicopter
etymology: Blend of 'medical' and 'evacuation,' coined during the Korean War era
contextSentence: He and a comrade were making their way to a medevac helicopter.
contextSentenceKo: 그와 전우는 의무 후송 헬기를 향해 이동하고 있었습니다.

definition: to give up something valued for the sake of something else regarded as more important
contextSentence: Who are willing to sacrifice themselves so that others may gain.
contextSentenceKo: 다른 사람들이 이익을 얻을 수 있도록 기꺼이 자신을 희생하는 사람들입니다.

definition: the ability or power to do, experience, or understand something
etymology: Latin 'capacitas' from 'capax' meaning 'able to hold much'
contextSentence: Every single one of us has the capacity to do these remarkable things.
contextSentenceKo: 우리 모두에게는 이런 놀라운 일을 해낼 수 있는 역량이 있습니다.

definition: the process of working together to achieve the same goal
contextSentence: It's this deep sense of trust and cooperation.
contextSentenceKo: 그것은 바로 깊은 신뢰와 협력의 감각입니다.

definition: to direct or command someone to do something; to teach
contextSentence: I can't simply instruct two people to cooperate and they will.
contextSentenceKo: 단순히 두 사람에게 협력하라고 지시한다고 해서 협력이 되는 것은 아닙니다.

definition: relating to the early phase of the Stone Age, lasting about 2.5 million years
contextSentence: If you go back 50,000 years to the Paleolithic era.
contextSentenceKo: 5만 년 전 구석기 시대로 거슬러 올라가 보면요.

definition: existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute
contextSentence: There are inherent benefits to this.
contextSentenceKo: 여기에는 본질적인 이점이 있습니다.

definition: no longer produced or used; out of date
etymology: Latin 'obsoletus' past participle of 'obsolescere' meaning 'to fall into disuse'
contextSentence: A new technology that renders your business model obsolete overnight.
contextSentenceKo: 하룻밤 사이에 당신의 사업 모델을 구식으로 만들어 버리는 새로운 기술입니다.

definition: clear and definite; real; able to be touched or felt
contextSentence: To sacrifice their comforts and sacrifice the tangible results.
contextSentenceKo: 자신의 안락함을 희생하고 실질적인 성과를 포기하는 것입니다.

definition: relating to deep inward feelings rather than to the intellect; instinctive
contextSentence: This is the reason so many people have such a visceral hatred.
contextSentenceKo: 이것이 바로 그토록 많은 사람들이 본능적인 증오심을 갖는 이유입니다.

definition: too large or too small in comparison with something else; out of proportion
contextSentence: With their disproportionate salaries and bonus structures.
contextSentenceKo: 그들의 불균형적인 급여와 보너스 구조와 함께 말입니다.

definition: to break or fail to comply with a rule or formal agreement; to treat with disrespect
etymology: Latin 'violare' meaning 'to treat with violence' from 'vis' (force)
contextSentence: They have violated the very definition of leadership.
contextSentenceKo: 그들은 리더십의 본질적 정의 자체를 위반한 것입니다.

definition: a period of temporary economic decline during which trade and industrial activity are reduced
etymology: Latin 'recessio' from 'recedere' meaning 'to go back, retreat'
contextSentence: He was hit very hard by the recession.
contextSentenceKo: 그는 경기 침체에 큰 타격을 받았습니다.

definition: a temporary leave of absence, especially from military duty or employment
contextSentence: And so they came up with a furlough program.
contextSentenceKo: 그래서 그들은 순환 휴직 프로그램을 고안해 냈습니다.

definition: the confidence, enthusiasm, and discipline of a person or group at a particular time
contextSentence: And morale went up.
contextSentenceKo: 그리고 사기가 올라갔습니다.

definition: in a way that is natural and without planning or prompting
etymology: Latin 'spontaneus' from 'sponte' meaning 'of one's own accord'
contextSentence: And quite spontaneously, nobody expected.
contextSentenceKo: 그리고 아무도 예상하지 못한 채, 아주 자발적으로 일어났습니다.

definition: the power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience
contextSentence: They are authorities. And we do what they say because they have authority over us.
contextSentenceKo: 그들은 권위자입니다. 그리고 우리는 그들이 우리에 대한 권한을 가지고 있기 때문에 그들의 말을 따릅니다.

definition: in a way that shows great effort and energy that does not stop
contextSentence: And work tirelessly to face the dangers outside.
contextSentenceKo: 그리고 바깥의 위험에 맞서기 위해 지치지 않고 일합니다.

definition: a companion who shares one's activities or is a fellow member of an organization
contextSentence: It shows Captain Swenson and his comrade bringing this wounded soldier.
contextSentenceKo: 스웬슨 대위와 그의 전우가 부상당한 병사를 데려오는 장면입니다.
